# `Q-12-26` — Listing Item Prose Has More Than One Paragraph

> A listing item's `title`, `subtitle` or `description` is written as
> more than one block, so the listing joins it into one paragraph.

## What this means

A listing shows each item's `title`, `subtitle` and `description` as a
single paragraph of markdown. This warning fires when one of them is
written as more than one block, most often a `description:` using a
YAML block scalar with a blank line in it:

``` markdown
---
title: My post
description: |
  The first paragraph.

  The second paragraph.
---
```

The listing joins the blocks into one paragraph ("The first paragraph.
The second paragraph."). Lists, block quotes and code blocks are
flattened to their text in the same way.

## How to fix

Write the value as one paragraph. Inline formatting (emphasis, code,
links) is kept:

``` markdown
---
title: My post
description: "The first paragraph, and *the second* folded into it."
---
```

If the item comes from a `listing-item:` block or an inline listing
record, fix the value there; the warning names the key it found.
